title: Course
description: One course. Materialises as a COVER row (CLASS_WEEK=0, BOOK_TYPE='COVER') in GT_CLASS_COURSE plus one MAIN row per lesson.

slug.description: Permanent identity. Must equal the directory name. Never reuse a retired slug.

curriculumType.description: GT_CLASS_COURSE.CURRICULUM_TYPE. Also forms le_tutor_curriculum.curriculum_type as PODO_{LANG}_{value}. Part of the course's identity — grape rejects a second course with the same (LANG_TYPE, CURRICULUM_TYPE, LESSON_TIME, CLASS_LEVEL), so a new type is a clean namespace rather than a label. BASIC_V2 is the interactive HTML curriculum; it is deliberately not BASIC so it can reuse level bands and so tutors opt into it separately. NOTE: the column is COLLATE utf8mb3_bin, so this value is CASE-SENSITIVE — 'BASIC_v2' or 'basic_v2' would each be a different, tutor-less curriculum that nothing reports.

classLevel.description: GT_CLASS_COURSE.CLASS_LEVEL. Quoted so 1.10 does not become 1.1. Grape truncates past 3 decimals.

thumbnail.description: Course-relative path to an image. Uploaded, then its URL written to BOOK_THUMBNAIL.

localised.description: Serialised to a JSON column. ko is required because grape falls back to it for the admin list.
